caption: Equatorial and Galactic Aitoff rotations of the same covered sky cells. For each distance shell the primary and strict densities share a color scale from the 2nd to 98th percentiles of positive pixel densities. The bottom row gives strict retention. Blank sky is outside the random-area coverage. The tail includes all probabilities beyond 10 kpc. The sensitivity table uses the same cells and gives cuts at 20% and 50% covered area and a depth split among cells with at least 20% coverage.
